text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There, there, don't cry, Tama-chan.
...I understand how you feel all too well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... I ain't cryin'!
I mean, it is what it is!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—She was just strong!
My rival... was just stronger!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run, Oguri-chan.
As expected... you really are strong.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It's because the two of you were there.
That's how I was able to grow this strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tremendous roar of cheers suddenly erupted.
Every bit of it was directed at Oguri Cap,
who had just become the champion of an era.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Get out there!
I'll be waitin' for ya!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much...
for supporting me...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Within those few simple words lay all the overwhelming emotions of a girl who had reached the very pinnacle...
